credentialFloat.title: Doe Advisory

trust.statement: A practice built for owners who want numbers they can act on.

expertise.heading: Four areas, handled personally.
expertise.lede: Every engagement is scoped in writing and led personally, start to finish. Select an area to start the conversation.

services.title: Audit and Assurance
services.body: Statutory audits and assurance reviews planned around your year end. Findings explained in plain language, with a management letter you can actually use.

services.title: Tax and Compliance
services.body: Self Assessment, VAT, and payroll taxes on a single compliance calendar. Returns, reconciliations, and HMRC correspondence tracked in one place.

services.title: Financial Advisory
services.body: Monthly reports, cash flow reviews, and decision support for founders. Numbers prepared so you can act on them, not just file them.

services.title: Business Structuring
services.body: Entity selection, incorporation, and reorganisation at formation, growth, or succession. Set up correctly once, rather than fixed later.

why.heading: Why owners stay.
why.statement: Most accounting tells you what happened. Jane tells you what to do next.
why.body: Doe Advisory works with a small number of businesses at a time, so every client gets the partner, not the pipeline. Calls are returned, drafts are walked through, and nothing is filed while a question is still open.

values.title: Direct access
values.body: You speak with Jane on every matter. No hand offs, no juniors learning on your books.

values.title: Plain language
values.body: Technical positions translated into decisions. If it cannot be explained simply, it is not finished.

values.title: Fixed fees
values.body: Scope and fee agreed in writing before work begins. The invoice never contains surprises.

approach.heading: A calm process, from first call to final record.
approach.lede: Four steps, followed on every engagement. You always know what happens next.

steps.title: Introductory call
steps.body: Twenty minutes on your situation, your deadlines, and whether Jane is the right fit.

steps.title: Written scope
steps.body: A one page note covering deliverables, timelines, documents needed, and the fixed fee.

steps.title: Work in the open
steps.body: Evidence gathered, drafts shared, questions answered in plain language before anything is filed.

steps.title: Close with records
steps.body: Acknowledgements, workings, and a summary memo handed over, indexed and retrievable.

faq.heading: Questions owners usually ask.
faq.lede: Short answers. Anything longer deserves a call.

items.question: How do your fees work?
items.answer: Fixed fees agreed in writing before work begins, based on scope rather than hours. Retainers are available for year round compliance.

items.question: Will you handle my matter personally?
items.answer: Yes. Every engagement is led personally from start to finish. If capacity ever requires support, it is disclosed before you agree to anything.

items.question: We are behind on filings. Can you help?
items.answer: Usually yes. The first step is a review of what is outstanding and the exposure involved, then a catch up plan with timelines. Bring whatever records you have.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside London?
items.answer: Yes. Clients in Manchester are served in person on schedule, and remote clients across the UK through video calls and shared records.

items.question: What do you need from us to begin?
items.answer: A twenty minute call, then access to your books and prior filings. The written scope lists everything else. Most engagements start within a week.

faq.sideBody: Send them directly. You will hear back within two working days.

contact.heading: Tell us about your next financial decision.
contact.lede: A few lines are enough. Replies within two working days.
contact.hours: Monday to Friday, 9 to 5. Saturday by appointment.
contact.closing: Whether it is an approaching deadline, a notice you did not expect, or simply a year you want handled properly, the first step is a conversation. Bring whatever records you have. Doe Advisory will take it from there.

assurances.title: A reply, not a queue
assurances.body: Every enquiry is answered personally within two working days.

assurances.title: Clarity before commitment
assurances.body: A twenty minute call first. You will know the scope and the fixed fee before agreeing to anything.

assurances.title: One person throughout
assurances.body: Your matter is led personally from first message to final record.
